description_en: Creates execution plans for batch scheduled prefetch tasks
description_zh: 制定批量新增定时预热任务的计划
kebab_example: aliyun esa create-scheduled-preload-executions --executions SliceLen=10 EndTime=2024-06-04T02:02:09Z StartTime=2024-06-03T16:00:00Z Interval=30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateScheduledPreloadExecutions

parameters.help_en: The prefetch task ID, generated by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850459.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 预热任务ID，通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850459.html接口生成
parameters.name: id

fields.help_en: The end time of the scheduled prefetch plan, in ISO 8601 format (such as 2024-01-01T00:00:00+Z)
fields.help_zh: 定时预热计划结束时间，格式为 ISO 8601（如 2024-01-01T00:00:00+Z）
fields.name: end_time

fields.help_en: The interval between each batch execution of the scheduled prefetch plan, in seconds
fields.help_zh: 定时预热计划每批执行间隔，单位秒
fields.name: interval

fields.help_en: The number of URLs to prefetch per batch
fields.name: slice_len

fields.help_en: The start time of the scheduled prefetch plan, in ISO 8601 format (such as 2024-01-01T00:00:00+Z)
fields.help_zh: 定时预热计划开始时间，格式为 ISO 8601（如 2024-01-01T00:00:00+Z）
fields.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The list of execution plans to be added for the scheduled prefetch task
parameters.help_zh: 待添加的定时预热任务执行计划列表
parameters.name: executions

FailedExecutions.description_en: The information about prefetch plans that failed to be added
FailedExecutions.description_zh: 添加失败的预热计划信息

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the scheduled prefetch plan, in ISO 8601 format (such as 2024-01-01T00:00:00+Z)
EndTime.description_zh: 定时预热计划结束时间，格式为 ISO 8601（如 2024-01-01T00:00:00+Z）

Interval.description_en: The interval between each batch execution of the scheduled prefetch plan, in seconds
Interval.description_zh: 定时预热计划每批执行间隔，单位秒

SliceLen.description_en: The number of URLs to prefetch per batch

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the scheduled prefetch plan, in ISO 8601 format (such as 2024-01-01T00:00:00+Z)
StartTime.description_zh: 定时预热计划开始时间，格式为 ISO 8601（如 2024-01-01T00:00:00+Z）

Status.description_en:
The status of the scheduled prefetch plan. Valid values:
waiting: Waiting to be executed.
running: Being executed.
finished: Execution completed.
failed: Execution failed.
stopped: Execution paused
Status.description_zh:
定时预热计划的状态，包括如下状态。
waiting：等待被执行。
running：正在执行中。
finished：执行完成。
failed：执行失败。
stopped：暂停执行中

FailedMessages.description_en: The list of failure messages for plans that failed to be added
FailedMessages.description_zh: 计划添加失败信息列表

items.example: execution id: 66599bd7397885b43804921c, error: end time is before start time.

SuccessCount.description_en: The number of prefetch plans that were successfully added
SuccessCount.description_zh: 成功新增的预热计划个数

SuccessExecutions.description_en: The information about prefetch plans that were successfully added
SuccessExecutions.description_zh: 添加成功的预热计划信息

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the scheduled prefetch plan, in ISO 8601 format (such as 2024-01-01T00:00:00+Z)
